objects.description: Disjoint-set union (union–find) structure with union by size and path compression. Field e stores parent/size; type vi is assumed to be a vector<int> alias defined elsewhere. Constructors take n to create n singleton sets.

functions.name: sgn
functions.signature: template <class T> int sgn(T x)
functions.description: Returns the sign of x as -1, 0, or 1 depending on whether x is negative, zero, or positive. Intended for numeric-like types that support comparison with 0.
requirements: T must support the relational operators (x > 0) and (x < 0).
For user-defined numeric types, the comparisons with literal 0 must be valid or suitably overloaded.
No side effects; pure function.

functions.name: Point<T>::operator<
functions.signature: template <class T> bool Point<T>::operator<(Point<T> p) const
functions.description: Lexicographic comparison of two points: first compares x, then y. Useful for sorting points in containers.
requirements: T must be comparable with operator<.
No modification of either point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::operator==
functions.signature: template <class T> bool Point<T>::operator==(Point<T> p) const
functions.description: Checks coordinate-wise equality between two points (x and y).
requirements: T must be comparable with operator==.
No modification of either point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::operator+
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::operator+(Point<T> p) const
functions.description: Vector addition of two points, returning the element-wise sum.
requirements: T must support addition (x+p.x and y+p.y).
No modification of either point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::operator-
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::operator-(Point<T> p) const
functions.description: Vector subtraction of two points, returning the element-wise difference.
requirements: T must support subtraction (x-p.x and y-p.y).
No modification of either point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::operator*
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::operator*(T d) const
functions.description: Scalar multiplication of a point by a scalar d, scaling both coordinates.
requirements: T must support multiplication (x*d and y*d).
Beware of overflow when T is integral and values are large.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::operator/
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::operator/(T d) const
functions.description: Scalar division of a point by a scalar d, dividing both coordinates.
requirements: T must support division (x/d and y/d).
d must not be 0 to avoid division-by-zero.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::dot
functions.signature: template <class T> T Point<T>::dot(Point<T> p) const
functions.description: Returns the dot product x*p.x + y*p.y of two points viewed as vectors.
requirements: T must support multiplication and addition (x*p.x + y*p.y).
No modification of either point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::cross
functions.signature: template <class T> T Point<T>::cross(Point<T> p) const
functions.description: Returns the 2D cross product x*p.y - y*p.x of two vectors, equal to the signed area (twice) of the parallelogram they form.
requirements: T must support multiplication and subtraction (x*p.y - y*p.x).
No modification of either point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::dist2
functions.signature: template <class T> T Point<T>::dist2() const
functions.description: Returns the squared Euclidean length of the vector (x*x + y*y).
requirements: T must support multiplication and addition.
Beware of overflow for large coordinates when T is integral.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::dist
functions.signature: template <class T> double Point<T>::dist() const
functions.description: Returns the Euclidean length of the vector as a double using sqrt((double)dist2()).
requirements: Requires <cmath> for sqrt.
Potential precision loss when casting large T to double.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::angle
functions.signature: template <class T> double Point<T>::angle() const
functions.description: Returns the polar angle of the vector relative to the x-axis in radians in [-pi, pi] using atan2(y, x).
requirements: Requires <cmath> for atan2.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::unit
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::unit() const
functions.description: Returns a unit-length vector in the same direction by dividing by dist().
requirements: The point must be non-zero length; dist() must not be 0 to avoid division-by-zero.
Requires <cmath> via dist().
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::perp
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::perp() const
functions.description: Returns the vector rotated +90 degrees counterclockwise: (-y, x).
requirements: T must support unary negation and copying.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::normal
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::normal() const
functions.description: Returns a unit-length vector perpendicular to this vector (perp().unit()).
requirements: The point must be non-zero length to allow normalization (unit).
Requires <cmath> via unit().
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: Point<T>::rotate
functions.signature: template <class T> Point<T> Point<T>::rotate(double a) const
functions.description: Returns the point rotated by angle a (radians) counterclockwise around the origin using x*cos(a)-y*sin(a), x*sin(a)+y*cos(a).
requirements: Requires <cmath> for std::sin and std::cos.
Angle a is in radians.
No modification of the point (const method).

functions.name: operator<<
functions.signature: template <class T> std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& os, Point<T> p)
functions.description: Stream insertion operator that prints a point in the format (x,y).
requirements: Requires <ostream>.
Relies on T being streamable to std::ostream.
Writes to os and returns it.

functions.name: lineInter
functions.signature: template <class P> std::pair<int, P> lineInter(P s1, P e1, P s2, P e2)
functions.description: Computes the intersection of the infinite lines through segments s1->e1 and s2->e2. Returns {1, point} if a unique intersection exists, {0, (0,0)} if none (parallel, non-coincident), and {-1, (0,0)} if infinitely many (collinear).
requirements: Type P must support: subtraction (operator-), cross product method cross, scalar multiplication by a scalar type (operator*), scalar division (operator/), and construction from two scalars P(0,0).
If the lines are parallel (d == 0), returns {-1, (0,0)} when they are collinear, else {0, (0,0)}.
When P uses integral coordinates, the returned intersection may be truncated/incorrect if it is non-integer (as noted).
Intermediate computations use products of three coordinates; risk of overflow for small integer types (int/long long). Consider wider types or floating point.

functions.name: UF::sameSet
functions.signature: bool UF::sameSet(int a, int b)
functions.description: Returns true if elements a and b belong to the same disjoint set (component).
requirements: UF must be constructed with a non-negative size n before use.
Indices a and b must satisfy 0 <= a,b < n.
No side effects beyond path-compression in find.

functions.name: UF::size
functions.signature: int UF::size(int x)
functions.description: Returns the size of the set containing element x.
requirements: UF must be constructed with a non-negative size n before use.
Index x must satisfy 0 <= x < n.
May perform path compression via find.

functions.name: UF::find
functions.signature: int UF::find(int x)
functions.description: Finds and returns the representative (root) of the set containing x, with path compression.
requirements: UF must be constructed with a non-negative size n before use.
Index x must satisfy 0 <= x < n.
May modify internal parent array to compress paths.

functions.name: UF::join
functions.signature: bool UF::join(int a, int b)
functions.description: Unites the sets containing a and b using union by size/rank; returns false if they are already in the same set, true otherwise.
requirements: UF must be constructed with a non-negative size n before use.
Indices a and b must satisfy 0 <= a,b < n.
Post-condition: either sets are unchanged (already united) or are merged with one root parent and sizes updated.
